title: Internal Assessment II: Hall Ticket Collection
body: Hall tickets for Internal Assessment II are ready. Collect them from the department office with your college ID card. Students with attendance below 75% must meet their class advisor first.

title: TCS Digital Drive: Registration Closing Soon
body: Final-year AI & DS students can register for the TCS Digital hiring drive through the placement portal. Keep your updated resume and CGPA proof ready. Only registered students will get the test link.

title: Workshop: MLOps with Docker and Kubernetes
body: A two-day hands-on workshop on packaging and deploying machine learning models, led by an industry speaker. Seats are limited to 60. Bring your own laptop with Docker installed.

title: Library Timings Extended During Exams
body: The central library will stay open until 9 PM on all working days during the internal assessment period. The digital library lab remains open till 8 PM.

title: Hackathon: AI for Good 2026
body: A 24-hour inter-department hackathon on AI for social good. Teams of 3 to 4. Problem statements will be shared on registration. Cash prizes for the top three teams.

title: Lab Record Submission: Data Structures
body: Submit the completed Data Structures lab record to your lab in-charge. Late submissions will not be accepted after the due date.
